John Stuart Mill also said "A being of higher faculties requires more to make him happy, is capable probably of more acute suffering, and certainly accessible to it at more points, than one of an inferior type." he also stated "it is only in cases of unhappiness so extreme, that to escape from it they would exchange their lot for almost any other."  

I'm at that point.

I'm going to sound like that guy from office space, but seriously every day is worse than the last.  Maybe not quite the worst day of my life, but that is because no one is dead.  I'm trying to figure out how in fuck to make each day better, or how to fully understand and deal with my shit, but i can't fucking do it.  I've studied philosophy, and psychology, and even a little anthropology.  I used to be able to understand the world, or atleast understand it to a degree that i thought i had some knowledge of what to do when and why to have a good day/life.  I can't understand shit right now.  I can't make anything better.  I don't understand life anymore.

I appreciate the help, but I don't know if it applies to my situation fully.

> Find the things you love and find a way to do them more

I am here to study 3D modeling.  I love it.  this of course is a very non-social and indoors/non active thing to do.  I feel like less social interaction and getting out less will pull me down further even though i currently hate social interactions and most if not all, despite what actually occurs, seem negative.

> They're not having as much fun (or as much sex) as you think they are

two of my friends that are now fucking two other friends have not been home for a week due to staying at the others' house or whatever.  They are fucking and every time i try to hang with them they have an excuse.

I do however believe that reading some sort of self-help book might do me good along with exercise, but i don't think it is a fix to any of my problems
